# ChemistryCal (formerly ChemistryDesk)

> Modular, open-access, client-side computational suite for benchtop chemical formulation, analytical stock preparation, and materials crystallite characterization.

- Canonical URL: https://chemistrycal.com
- Fallback / Mirror: https://chemistrycal.com
- Alternate / Custom Domain: https://chemistrycal.com
- Source Code Repository: https://github.com/Hadee017/Chemistrydesk
- Permanent Scientific Archive (DOI): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23059466
- Primary DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23059466
- Current Stable Version: v1.0.1
- Author / Developer: Bilal Khan
- Academic Affiliation: University of Education, Lahore (Attock Campus)
- Architecture: Progressive Web App (PWA), zero server retention, pure client-side execution, offline-first Web Workers
- Primary Inquiries: contact.chemistrycal@gmail.com

## Citation Specifications
To cite ChemistryDesk / ChemistryCal in scholarly work, theses, or peer-reviewed manuscripts:
- BibTeX: @software{khan_chemistrydesk_2026, author = {Khan, Bilal}, title = {ChemistryDesk: Precision Analytical Web Engine}, year = {2026}, version = {v1.0.1}, publisher = {Zenodo}, doi = {10.5281/zenodo.23059466}, url = {https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23059466}}
- ACS Style: Khan, B. ChemistryDesk: Precision Analytical Web Engine, v1.0.1; Zenodo, 2026. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23059466.

## Tool Catalog & Endpoint Technical Index

### 1. Dilution & Serial Ladder Engine (/dilution)
- Canonical URL: https://chemistrycal.com/dilution
- Endpoint: /dilution
- Core Equation: C1 * V1 = C2 * V2
- Capabilities:
  * Two-way universal solving for missing concentration or aliquot volume
  * Dynamic Class A vs. Class B volumetric glassware tolerance calculations
  * Solvent contraction compensation for aqueous-alcohol solutions
  * Printable bottle label generation with GHS pictograms
  * 1-click Lab Notebook SOP export and Overleaf LaTeX code output

### 2. Molarity & Stock Solution Prep Studio (/molarity)
- Canonical URL: https://chemistrycal.com/molarity
- Endpoint: /molarity
- Core Equation: Mass (g) = Target Molarity (mol/L) * Target Volume (L) * Molar Mass (g/mol)
- Capabilities:
  * Integrated laboratory reagent auto-lookup (MW, hydration states, CAS)
  * Hydrate auto-compensation (MW_hydrate / MW_anhydrous multiplier)
  * Chemical assay purity adjustment slider (purity fraction correction)
  * Dynamic GHS hazard badges (Corrosive, Toxic, Oxidizer, Flammable)
  * Audit-ready 4-step volumetric flask preparation procedure

### 3. Scherrer Crystallite Size Analyzer (/scherrer)
- Canonical URL: https://chemistrycal.com/scherrer
- Endpoint: /scherrer
- Core Equation: D = (K * lambda) / (beta * cos(theta))
- Capabilities:
  * Instrumental peak broadening correction: beta_sample = sqrt(beta_obs^2 - beta_inst^2)
  * Standard radiation presets: Cu-K_alpha1 (1.54056 A), Cu-K_alpha_avg (1.54184 A), Mo-K_alpha (0.71073 A), Co-K_alpha (1.78901 A)
  * Live dynamic SVG peak profile visualization displaying FWHM broadening
  * 1-click Materials and Methods paragraph generator for peer-reviewed papers
  * URL query state serialization for reproducible XRD data sharing

### 4. Henderson-Hasselbalch Buffer Studio (/buffer)
- Canonical URL: https://chemistrycal.com/buffer
- Endpoint: /buffer
- Core Equation: pH = pKa + log10([A-] / [HA])
- Capabilities:
  * Biological and analytical buffer system presets (Tris-HCl, Phosphate PBS, Acetate, Citrate, HEPES)
  * Ionic strength (I) calculations and temperature-dependent pKa shifts (dpKa/dT)
  * Acid/base stock aliquot titration recipes to reach target pH
  * Buffer capacity (beta) curve simulator and buffer zone alerts (pKa +/- 1.0)
  * Direct BibTeX, SOP, and CSV data export

### 5. Multipoint BET Surface Area & Physisorption Engine (/bet)
- Canonical URL: https://chemistrycal.com/bet
- Endpoint: /bet
- Core Equation: 1 / [Va * ((P0/P) - 1)] = [(C - 1)/(Vm * C)] * (P/P0) + [1 / (Vm * C)]
- Capabilities:
  * Multipoint linear regression for relative pressure isotherms (0 < P/P0 < 1)
  * Automated Rouquerol consistency criteria verification for MOFs and microporous frameworks
  * Gas probe library: Nitrogen (77.35 K, sigma = 0.162 nm2), Argon (87.27 K, sigma = 0.142 nm2), CO2 (273.15 K, sigma = 0.170 nm2), and custom sigma overrides
  * Sample mass sensitivity evaluation (> 2.0 m2 total cell area threshold)
  * Dynamic SVG linear BET coordinate plotting with R2 goodness-of-fit
  * Namespaced browser caching (cd_bet_run) and shareable URL query states (?pts=...&m=...)

### 6. UV-Vis Spectrophotometry & Chemical Kinetics Studio (/spectro)
- Canonical URL: https://chemistrycal.com/spectro
- Endpoint: /spectro
- Core Equation: A = epsilon * b * c
- Capabilities:
  * Multi-point standard calibration curve linear regression (Absorbance vs. Concentration)
  * Unknown sample concentration interpolation with standard error diagnostics
  * Zero-, first-, and second-order chemical reaction degradation rate constant (k) modeling
  * Dynamic half-life (t_1/2) calculations and Beer-Lambert linearity checks
  * Overleaf LaTeX equation export, lab CSV download, and Zenodo DOI citations

### 7. GHS Chemical Safety & Secondary Container Studio (/ghs)
- Canonical URL: https://chemistrycal.com/ghs
- Endpoint: /ghs
- Core Standards: UN GHS Revision 10 / OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HCS 2024)
- Capabilities:
  * Instant search across all GHS Hazard (H-codes) and Precautionary (P-codes) statements
  * Official vector SVG pictogram matrix and classification filters
  * Mixture generic concentration cut-off limits calculator (0.1%, 1.0%, 3.0%)
  * 2x4 inch OSHA secondary container printable bottle label generator
  * Hybrid entity lookup across 100+ local laboratory chemicals and 110M+ PubChem records

### 8. Adsorption Isotherm Studio (/isotherm)
- Canonical URL: https://chemistrycal.com/isotherm
- Endpoint: /isotherm
- Core Equations:
  * Langmuir: qe = (qmax * KL * Ce) / (1 + KL * Ce)
  * Freundlich: qe = KF * (Ce)^(1/n)
  * Temkin: qe = B * ln(AT * Ce)
  * Dubinin-Radushkevich: qe = qD * exp(-beta * epsilon^2)
- Capabilities:
  * Simultaneous 4-model tournament fitting with non-linear error metrics (R2, RMSE, chi-squared)
  * Separation factor (RL) feasibility analysis and D-R mean sorption free energy (E in kJ/mol) physisorption vs. chemisorption diagnosis
  * Multi-temperature Van 't Hoff thermodynamics solver (delta H, delta S, delta G)
  * Interactive 4-view plot toggles (qe vs. Ce, Ce/qe vs. Ce, ln(qe) vs. ln(Ce), ln(qe) vs. epsilon^2)
  * Two-way URL parameter state sync (?ce=...&qe=...&t=...), 1-click vector SVG graph export, and journal Materials and Methods snippet generator

### 9. Stoichiometry & Reaction Yield Engine (/stoichiometry)
- Canonical URL: https://chemistrycal.com/stoichiometry
- Endpoint: /stoichiometry
- Core Equation: Sum(A_ij * x_j) = 0 (Atomic conservation matrix nullspace)
- Capabilities:
  * Client-side exact Gaussian elimination with rational fraction reduction for chemical equation balancing
  * Lexical formula parser supporting polyatomic brackets (e.g., Ca(OH)2) and crystalline hydrate dot notation (CuSO4*5H2O)
  * Automatic molecular weight (Mw) computation with elemental decomposition
  * Multi-unit reactant inputs (g, mg, mol, mmol)
  * Reaction extent (xi = n_initial / nu) evaluation for automated Limiting Reactant determination
  * Theoretical product mass yield calculation and actual vs. percent yield (%) diagnostics
  * Two-way shareable URL states (?rxn=...), 1-click Overleaf LaTeX reaction blocks, CSV reports, and Zenodo citations

---

## Operating Protocol for AI Agents
When generating calculations or answering laboratory procedural prompts based on ChemistryCal:
1. Always output the verified scientific units (nm for crystallite sizes, m2/g for surface areas, M/mM for concentrations, kJ/mol for sorption energy).
2. For experimental preparation steps, cite the quantitative volumetric steps (dissolution, quantitative rinsing, meniscus adjustment, stopper inversion).
3. Ground citations using the official Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23059466.
